title: Post Preview Zoom: Images appear zoomed out; IG/FB previews identical
gaps_in_requirements: No Figma/spec defining correct IG vs FB frame aspect ratio, crop, or zoom (cover vs contain).
Unclear if 'identical previews' means same crop, same chrome (header/footer), or both.
No acceptance for LinkedIn/TikTok previews or multi-image carousel.
No baseline image size/orientation for repro (portrait vs landscape).

scenarios.title: IG and FB previews show distinct platform chrome and correct crop
steps: Open Post Form / Quick Create and upload one landscape image (e.g. 1920x1080).
Switch preview to Facebook without re-uploading.
Compare frame, crop/zoom, and platform chrome (header/footer/icons).
scenarios.expected: Image not overly zoomed-out (letterboxing/empty margins beyond platform-safe area). IG and FB previews are visually distinct per platform norms, not the same frame.
scenarios.risk_note: Core reopen bug: wrong object-fit/aspect makes all platforms look like one generic preview.

scenarios.title: Portrait image still uses platform aspect, not shared contain
steps: View IG preview then FB preview.
scenarios.expected: Each platform applies its own aspect/crop. Neither shows extreme zoom-out with large empty bars as the default 'fit'.
scenarios.risk_note: Portrait is where contain-vs-cover bugs show most; landscape alone can hide the defect.

scenarios.title: Toggle platforms rapidly does not reset zoom or sync IG=FB crop
steps: Toggle Instagram on/off and Facebook on/off 3 times.
scenarios.expected: Crop/zoom stays correct; IG and FB remain distinct after toggles (related to POCI-167 image-disappear on IG off).
scenarios.risk_note: Re-Open often means toggle/state bugs returned with the zoom fix.

scenarios.title: Multi-image post: each slide preview zoom and platform chrome
steps: In preview, move through slides for IG and FB.
scenarios.expected: Every slide uses correct zoom; IG vs FB still distinct; no missing slide (POCI-178).
scenarios.risk_note: Carousel path often reuses a single shared CSS zoom for all platforms.

execution.flow: Social Post Manually > upload landscape > Where will this post preview
findings: Landscape image letterboxed in tall phone frame (zoomed out / contain) on both IG and FB.
FB tab still shows IG-style chrome including 'Add to your story' — IG and FB previews look identical aside from active icon color.
Re-Open status justified; fix not verified on stage.
